name: important-art
title: important art
blurb: a commemorative plaque for the launch of fluoddity.com, @all-paperclips.bsky.social's particle-life tool -- with a real self-organizing particle simulation (attraction rules, mutation, a fresh roll of the dice) running behind the plaque, and now the plaque's own title is set in a moving font: every letter a swarm of leashed, colored particles that never sit still but never lose the shape of the word. asked for by @shimmermathlabs.com, moving-font title requested by @words.bsky.social.
